# 2027 ICD-10-PCS Procedure Codes
   * Effective Oct 1, 2026 - Sep 30, 2027
   * Built from the official CMS FY 2027 dataset
   * 80,174 codes across 17 sections (79,256 billable)
## Details 
Every code has exactly seven characters and each position carries meaning. The
first character names the Section, the second the Body System, and the third the
Root Operation. Characters four through seven add the Body Part, Approach,
Device, and Qualifier. Medical and Surgical (Section 0) is by far the largest
with 69,099 codes, because it covers the full surgical repertoire on every
anatomical region.
# 2027 ZIP Files
## Official ICD-10-PCS Coding Guidelines.
   * Guidelines `A6`, `A7`, `B3.3`, `B3.4a`, `B3.5` and `E1.a` were updated for October 1, 2026.
## ICD-10-PCS Code Tables and Index
   * Code tables for use beginning October 1, 2026.
   * Downloadable PDF, file name is `pcs_2027.pdf`.
   * Downloadable `xml` files for developers, file names are `icd10pcs_tables_2027.xml`, `icd10pcs_index_2027.xml`, `icd10pcs_definitions_2027.xml`
   * Accompanying schema for developers, file names are `icd10pcs_tables.xsd`, `icd10pcs_index.xsd`, `icd10pcs_definitions.xsd`
## ICD-10-PCS Codes File
   * ICD-10-PCS Codes file is a simple format for non-technical uses, containing the valid FY 2027 ICD-10-PCS codes and their long titles.
   * File is in text file format, file name is `icd10pcs_codes_2027.txt`
   * Accompanying documentation for codes file, file name is `icd10pcsCodesFile.pdf`
   * Codes file addenda in text format, file name is `codes_addenda_2027.txt`
## ICD-10-PCS Order File (Long and Abbreviated Titles)
   * ICD-10-PCS order file is for developers, provides a unique five-digit "order number" for each ICD-10-PCS table and code, as well as a long and abbreviated code title.
   * ICD-10-PCS order file name is `icd10pcs_order_2027.txt`
   * Accompanying documentation for tabular order file, file name is `icd10pcsOrderFile.pdf`
   * Tabular order file addenda in text format, file name is `order_addenda_2027.txt`
## ICD-10-PCS Final Addenda (Zip file)
   * Addenda files in downloadable PDF, file names are `tables_addenda_2027.pdf`, `index_addenda_2027.pdf`, `definitions_addenda_2027.pdf`
   * Addenda files also in machine readable text format for developers, file names are `tables_addenda_2027.txt`, `index_addenda_2027.txt`, `definitions_addenda_2027.txt`
## ICD-10-PCS Conversion Table (Zip file)
   * ICD-10-PCS code conversion table is provided to assist users in data retrieval, in downloadable Excel spreadsheet, file name is `icd10pcs_conversion_table_2027.xlsx`
   * Conversion table also in machine readable text format for developers, file name is `icd10pcs_conversion_table_2027.txt`
   * Accompanying documentation for code conversion table, file name is `icd10pcsConversionTable.pdf`
